snippet.title: LumaWorlds Trailer
snippet.description:
LumaWorlds is a 2D multiplayer sandbox game centered on its deep item crafting system, player-driven economy, and persistent, community-built worlds.

Play for FREE on PC.
https://importgames.itch.io/lumaworlds

Join the Discord community!
https://discord.gg/s2mrtC34

Trailer Music:
rezoner - Happy Arcade Tune, https://opengameart.org/content/happy-arcade-tune
